in_sanskrit.name: अमोलराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अमो (Amol) - Immeasurable, लो (Lo) - King, राज (Raj) - King

in_marathi.name: Amolraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amolraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amolraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Amol' meaning 'Immortal' and 'Raj' meaning 'Ruler'. In Hindu mythology, Amolraj is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe.
